age_verdict: Accelerated Organ Aging: 20.0 Years Older than Chronological Age

markers.name: Apolipoprotein B (ApoB)
markers.clinical_note: ApoB reflects total atherogenic particle concentration; target < 60 mg/dL halts arterial plaque progression.

markers.name: Lipoprotein(a) [Lp(a)]
markers.clinical_note: Genetically determined cardiovascular risk factor; non-modifiable by diet, requires targeted risk mitigation.
markers.citation: Tsimikas S. J Am Coll Cardiol 2017; 69(6): 692-711

markers.name: Triglyceride to HDL Ratio
markers.clinical_note: Surpassing indicator of atherogenic small dense LDL particles and hepatic insulin resistance.
markers.citation: McLaughlin T et al. Ann Intern Med 2003; 139(10): 802-9

markers.name: Homocysteine
markers.clinical_note: Elevated homocysteine induces vascular endothelial toxicity and methylation impairment.
markers.citation: Clarke R et al. N Engl J Med 1991; 324(17): 1149-55

markers.name: Fasting Insulin
markers.clinical_note: Early biomarker of hyperinsulinemia and cellular insulin resistance, preceding glucose spikes by 10 years.
markers.citation: Kraft JR. Detection of Diabetes Mellitus In Situ (1975) / Crofts C et al. 2016

markers.name: Glycated Hemoglobin (HbA1c)
markers.clinical_note: Average 90-day glycemic control; values above 5.3% indicate microvascular protein glycation.
markers.citation: Selvin E et al. N Engl J Med 2010; 362(9): 800-11

markers.name: Fasting Blood Glucose
markers.clinical_note: Optimal fasting range prevents hepatic gluconeogenesis overshoot and glycation spikes.
markers.citation: Nichols GA et al. Diabetes Care 2008; 31(10): 2001-4

markers.name: Serum Uric Acid
markers.clinical_note: Values > 5.5 mg/dL suppress endothelial nitric oxide and signal fructose/purine metabolic stress.
markers.citation: Johnson RJ et al. Nat Rev Rheumatol 2013; 9(10): 630-40

markers.name: High-Sensitivity C-Reactive Protein (hs-CRP)
markers.clinical_note: Indicates low-grade subclinical vascular inflammation; levels > 0.5 mg/L indicate accelerated vascular aging.

markers.name: Alanine Aminotransferase (ALT)
markers.clinical_note: Levels above 25 U/L strongly correlate with occult non-alcoholic fatty liver disease (NAFLD).

markers.name: Gamma-Glutamyl Transferase (GGT)
markers.clinical_note: Ultra-sensitive marker for hepatic oxidative stress and systemic glutathione depletion.
markers.citation: Lee DH et al. Clin Chem 2004; 50(10): 1874-6

markers.name: Serum Albumin
markers.clinical_note: Crucial biomarker in Levine PhenoAge; higher levels indicate plasma oncotic and antioxidant capacity.
markers.citation: Levine ME. J Gerontol A Biol Sci Med Sci 2013; 68(6): 667-74

markers.name: 25-Hydroxy Vitamin D3
markers.clinical_note: Nuclear receptor ligand regulating expression of > 2,000 genes in innate immunity and longevity.
markers.citation: Holick MF. N Engl J Med 2007; 357(3): 266-81

markers.name: Vitamin B12 (Active Cobalamin)
markers.clinical_note: Essential co-factor for remethylation of homocysteine and neuro-protective myelin maintenance.
markers.citation: Stabler SP. N Engl J Med 2013; 368(2): 149-60

doctor.name: Dr. Aarav Mehta, MD
doctor.credentials: MD (Internal Medicine), Fellowship in Anti-Aging & Functional Medicine
